name: stacker two-floor rig
note: Purpose-built in game: two belt lines on separate floors into one straight stacker, one belt out. Built to settle where the stacker's second shape input sits.

name: unmeasured machines rig
note: Purpose-built in game on a 1x1 platform: every machine whose geometry was still unknown, each wired belt-in belt-out — half destroyer, both extra rotators, pin pusher, halves swapper, bent stacker, and a lift up and down.
